description: This file contains the configuration and transformation logic for BAAI General Embedding (BGE) models on Vertex AI. It includes classes and functions to identify BGE models, transform requests from OpenAI format to Vertex AI format, and transform Vertex AI responses back to OpenAI format. The focus is on request/response transformation specific to BGE models deployed on Vertex AI.

classes.name: VertexBGEConfig
classes.description: Class providing static methods for BGE model detection, request transformation, and response transformation tailored to Vertex AI BGE models.

methods.name: bool is_bge_model(model: str)
methods.description: Checks if a given model string corresponds to a BGE model based on its naming pattern.

methods.name: VertexEmbeddingRequest transform_request( input: Union[list, str], optional_params: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Transforms input data and optional parameters into a Vertex AI BGE embedding request.

methods.name: TextEmbeddingBGEInput _create_embedding_input( prompt: str, task_type: Optional[TaskType] = None, title: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a TextEmbeddingBGEInput object with the appropriate prompt and optional fields.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_response( response: dict, model: str, model_response: EmbeddingResponse )
methods.description: Transforms a Vertex AI response containing embeddings into the openai-like embedding response format.
